newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: South African brewer eyes Austrian market - report.
newsitem.headline: South African brewer eyes Austrian market - report.

text.p: Drinks giant South African Breweries (SAB) has bid five billion schillings for majority control of Austria's Brau Union, mass daily Kronenzeitung reported on Saturday.

Brau Union controls some two thirds of the Austrian beer market with an annual output of about eight million hectolitres. The group has wide-ranging interests in Hungary and other eastern European countries.
Brau Union currently is majority-controlled by Austria's Brau-Beteiligungs AG (BBAG), the country's biggest beverage holding group.
SAB is the world's fourth biggest beer maker and has interests in the Hungarian and Bulgarian market.
Brau Union has scheduled an extraordinary shareholders' meeting for next Tuesday to discuss the takeover bid, the paper said. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
